capabilities: Indent content under headings based on heading level
Customize indentation per heading level in plugin settings
Toggle indentation per note via a heading-indent frontmatter property
Indent code blocks, blockquotes, callouts, tables, LaTeX blocks and embeds in Source/Live Preview, Reading View and PDF export
extras: README includes a support table showing which element types are indented in Source/Live Preview, Reading View and PDF export; the demo section is empty in the provided text.
problem: Obsidian renders all content flush under headings regardless of heading level, making document structure harder to scan at a glance.
summary: Heading level indenter that visually indents content under each heading according to the heading's level.
